direction.statement: Seek a contradiction at any hypothetical right-half zeta zero by proving an independent estimate incompatible with the original Riesz carrier’s forced source limit. Preserve Möbius signs, logarithmic phases and full frequency correlations through conditioned-energy estimates. latestUpdate.title: An independent global Vinogradov exponent improvement is proved.
latestUpdate.body: Lean closes initial global conditioning and saves 1/(3k) over the elementary high-moment exponent for every k≥2 and u≥k, at every sufficiently large cutoff. The critical moment exponent, VK zeta growth and a larger zero-free region remain open. The README overview now keeps ten major formalisation highlights.
latestUpdate.next: Next: strengthen the global moment exponent and feed the improved estimate into the existing weighted and zeta-growth machinery.

scopes.sourceScope: Under the displayed hypothetical right-half-zero assumptions, the normalized original carrier has the prescribed negative-multiplicity source limit. scopes.initialConditioningScope: The full unweighted Vinogradov mean value now has an independent saving of 1/(3k) in its elementary exponent, for every k>=2 and u>=k and every sufficiently large cutoff. The prime packet, initial conditioning, finite allowance and extension to all large endpoints are proved without a supplied moment bound. The critical moment exponent, original weighted Riesz saving and VK zeta growth remain open; this auxiliary endpoint does not prove an RH contradiction or a larger zero-free region.
